start.text: (A man in a plain olive shirt, a map folded small in his hand.) Rathore. Don't salute — nobody's left to see it. You walked here from Indiranagar? Then you can walk to other places.

plan.text: My engineer says the purple kills the thing in their cells, if you focus it. A gun. He needs five things. First, medicines: the slot shop at Hebbal General, its stockroom.

gate.text: The camp gate, east side. Priya goes with you, if she likes you.

board.text: The list: medicines, a radio, battery cores, emitter parts. And one more, later.

later.text: The gate's east. The lamps are on till midnight.

thanks_1.text: Good. Tomorrow: the bus depot at Majestic. The kiosk had a two-way set.

thanks_2.text: Battery cores next. Church Street — the Reliable Digital counter.

thanks_3.text: The emitter parts are at HIVR. The lab corridor. (He looks at you a moment too long.) I'm sorry.

thanks_4.text: That's four. The fifth is in Malleswaram, a scientist's house. Not tonight.

cut.text: (The lamps along the line are dark.) They cut the line at midnight. The generators went to the Palace grounds, and the engineer with them. So do we, today.

go.text: Palace grounds. Walk in the middle of the road.
